## 1. About Katto

### Full Biography
Hi! I'm Katto, I am an artist, and tech enthusiast in general. I believe some of you reading this have met me by multiple names, including katt, void, fashui, or even cattleox if you've known me since the beginning.

I plan on studying medicine and pathology in the future, and/or maybe computer science.

I'm a furry, if that wasn't obvious from the header, I have NOT gone to any convention yet, but whenever I get a fursuit I probably will.

I don't like theres a twitch streamer with the same name that I have on my socials, it's pretty confusing to see multiple people with the same name. It makes me a bit sad now that I realize that I WAS the one who copied the name, well not really because a friend gave me the name "Kattosaurus" after I started going as "Kattstarzz" because He was named "Cattosaurus", Its a bit silly but yeah.

### Identity & Pronouns
- **Orientation:** Bisexual
- **Gender:** Non-binary
- **Pronouns:** Any pronouns

## 2. Services Offered

### A. Commissions
- **Description:** Affordable artwork primarily focused on furry art, but capable of drawing feral and human art.
- **Constraints:** **Strictly NO NSFW.** Available when slots are open.
- **Links:** `commission.html` / `commission/`

### B. Web Development
- **Description:** Custom website design and development matching styles like the portfolio or other custom layouts. 
- **Pricing/Terms:** Prices vary; hosting is not included.
- **Contact:** `whatever@katto.online` or Discord `@exp009`.

### C. Mod Development (Minecraft)
- **Description:** Custom Minecraft mod creation (specializing in Forge) or character integration into the custom Minecraft mod *Changed Extras*.
- **Links:** `portfolio.html` / `portfolio/`

---

## 3. Site Structure & Navigation Pages

- **`index.html` (Home):** Main landing page featuring the animated title header, biography section, and carousel of services.
- **`portfolio.html`:** Showcase of past coding, design, and modding projects.
- **`commission.html`:** Detailed commission pricing, guidelines, and terms of service.
- **`characters.html`:** Information regarding original characters and fursonas.
